title: Drive-not-build Flow-Lenia with a dilute matter background: gliders recruit conserved matter, multiply to 10-16 and reach generation 2-3 (reticulate), and all disperse within ~100 t when the food that sets their growth-field gain is removed (2/2 seeds)
summary: Follow-up to 20261025T1926-c18-fl-drive-sighting: same world with a uniform background of matter (bg 0.02 per channel; WORLD_P {"bg":0.02}), still exactly conserved (drift 2e-11). labkit (2 seeds, t=600): 9-14 gliders that travel 11-13 body lengths, 6 and 2 persistent splits with max generation 3 and 2, but merges about equal splits (merge/split 0.94-0.96) and 7-8 nucleations from the background. Fork at t=200 removing food and its regrowth: bodies 11 -> 0 (seed 0) and 7 -> 0 (seed 1) by t=300-325, while fed twins keep 10-16 to t=500 (dfork_bg02_s*.png). So body matter is never made from the resource, yet the bodies need it; division exists but is reticulate and mixed with nucleation. Limits as before: the food scales the whole growth field, no boundary layer, no per-body fork, 2 seeds.
